text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Right, I think that's enough for today's...
Hm?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: No, but it seems we have a spectator.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: An acquaintance of yours, I presume?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Nope. But if I remember correctly...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Phew. Another honest day's work! And
now, the event we've all been
waiting
for—Roll the McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I beg your pardon?! What a dreadful-sounding name! Whatever it is, we are not doing it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey! Come back here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I didn't know her, but I had seen her around. She was always the last one out practicing.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And there she was, running and running,
all by herself.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Ah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hnngh... Ow...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
All this running, and nothing to show for
it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was like watching McQueen all over
again, training for the Tenno
Sho as if her
life depended on it.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: You okay?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: You okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh... You're McQueen's trainer...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't run through the pain. Not if
you want to win your next
race.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't run through the pain. Not if
you want to win your next
race.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: It sucks you can't do more now, I know. But just hold on to that feeling, and it'll take you to the winner's circle.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Sob...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, uh... Didn't think you hurt yourself
that badly.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, uh... Didn't think you hurt yourself
that badly.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no, sorry, it's... it's just...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I love running... but I just can't seem to
win. And when I see McQueen
race—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I... I want to win too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I want to win." It's easy to say those words
once. But to Rice Shower,
they were a
mantra.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Me? In the Derby...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I know you can do it. I've watched you run
more than anyone.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I know you can do it. I've watched you run
more than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-but... I'm just not at that level.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't blame her for being intimidated.
The Derby draws the fiercest
contenders
around.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still, Rice has the legs to keep up with
McQueen. And more
importantly...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
That ambition is what leads to hard work.
And hard work is what leads
to
confidence.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: So what do you say? The Derby calls!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...O-okay. I'll give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It took a little prodding, but she's taken
her first step towards the
wide world that
awaits her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So all I have to do is follow McQueen?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Just follow the leader, no matter
what.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Just follow the leader, no matter
what.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Out of all the contenders for this year's
Derby, there's one clear
favorite: the
undefeated Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She takes the lead and sets a precise pace,
rather like a machine. It's
truly a sight to
behold.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you're to best her, you'll first need to be
able to keep up with me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. I'll try my best not to fall behind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not easy, keeping the perfect stalking
distance. It demands both
stamina and
focus, especially against someone like
McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice gets off to a rough start, falling
behind time and time again, but
she keeps
at it. And after a few days...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look at that! You didn't fall behind a
single time today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well done. That stamina will serve you
well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well then, farewell to you all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Smell ya later!

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text: See you tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Just keep following, just keep following...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Just keep following, just keep following...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Just keep following, just keep following...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Erm, Rice.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hweh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Do you mean to sleep beside me again? I'm not sure following me everywhere I go will benefit you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-but Trainer said to follow you, no matter
what.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(...This is most definitely not what Trainer
had in mind.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After several days of relentless training,
the highlight of the Twinkle
Series, the
Japanese Derby, is finally here.
